## 1. Organization & Entity Overview
- **Brand Entity**: Jayant Web & AI Systems (alternate: Jayant Systems)
- **Founder & Lead Software Engineer**: Jayant Olhyan
- **Academic Background**: B.Tech Computer Science (MSIT Delhi)
- **Primary Operational Focus**: Custom generative AI engineering, full-stack Next.js web application development, cross-platform mobile apps with Flutter, and business workflow automations.
- **Operating Model**: Remote engineering studio providing direct developer access, fixed-scope milestones, weekly live demo staging, and complete client intellectual property (IP) transfer.
- **Official Domain**: https://jayant-systems.online
- **Primary Support Email**: jayantwebaisystems@gmail.com
- **Direct Strategy Call Booking**: https://cal.com/jayant-web-and-ai-systems/strategy-call

## 2. Core Service Deliverables & Engineering Scope

### 2.1 AI Chatbot Development (`/services/ai-chatbot-development`)
- **Deliverables**: Bespoke conversational AI chatbots trained strictly on company knowledge bases, product manuals, and internal documentation.
- **Integrations**: Web embeds, WhatsApp Business API, Telegram, Slack, and CRM ticketing systems.
- **Supported Models & Frameworks**: OpenAI GPT-4, Google Gemini Pro, Anthropic Claude 3.5, LangChain, Pinecone, and Supabase pgvector.

### 2.2 Custom AI & LLM Systems (`/services/ai-development`)
- **Deliverables**: Enterprise AI feature development, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, multimodal document parsing engines, and autonomous operational agents.

### 2.3 Modern Website Development (`/services/website-development`)
- **Deliverables**: High-performance, SEO-first business websites engineered with Next.js App Router, React Server Components, and Tailwind CSS.
- **Standards**: 90+ Core Web Vitals performance, semantic schema metadata, responsive layout architectures, and sub-second load times.

### 2.4 Custom Software & Dashboard Development (`/services/custom-software-development`)
- **Deliverables**: Internal business operations tools, proprietary database architectures, custom admin panels, role-based access portals, and reporting dashboards.

### 2.5 Business Process & Workflow Automation (`/services/business-automation`)
- **Deliverables**: Elimination of manual data entry, webhook pipelines connecting lead sources to CRM platforms, automated PDF invoice generators, and automated WhatsApp alert routines.

### 2.6 Rapid Startup MVP Development (`/services/mvp-development` / `/promo/build-startup-mvp`)
- **Deliverables**: Launch-ready Minimum Viable Products shipped in 2 to 6 weeks with user authentication, database persistence, payment gateway integrations (Razorpay/Stripe), and cloud deployment.

### 2.7 Cross-Platform Mobile App Development (`/services/mobile-app-development`)
- **Deliverables**: Native-performance iOS and Android mobile applications engineered from a single codebase using Flutter with offline data caching and push notifications.

### 2.8 SaaS Platform Development (`/services/saas-development`)
- **Deliverables**: Multi-tenant cloud applications, subscription billing lifecycles, team workspace permissions, usage metering, and documented REST/GraphQL APIs.

### 2.9 Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps (`/services/cloud-and-devops`)
- **Deliverables**: Cloud server provisioning on AWS and Google Cloud, Docker containerization, automated CI/CD deployment pipelines, and uptime monitoring.

### 2.10 Software Maintenance Retainers (`/services/maintenance`)
- **Deliverables**: Monthly proactive security patches, automated database backups, library updates, bug fixes, and SLA-backed uptime monitoring.

| **Scale** | ₹2,00,000 (One-time) | Established companies & enterprises | Complete AI Business System: custom software architecture, private-data AI chatbot, WhatsApp automation workflows, multi-platform CRM sync, and 90 days priority support. | 4–8 Weeks |

## 4. Engineering Technology Stack

- **Frontend**: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion.
- **Backend & APIs**: Python, FastAPI, Node.js, Next.js Route Handlers.
- **Mobile**: Flutter, Dart.
- **Databases & State**: PostgreSQL, Supabase (Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, pgvector), Redis.
- **Artificial Intelligence & LLMs**: OpenAI (GPT-4o), Google Gemini 1.5/2.0 Pro, Anthropic Claude 3.5, LangChain, Vector Databases (Pinecone, ChromaDB).
- **DevOps & Cloud**: Docker, AWS (EC2, S3, CloudFront), Google Cloud Platform, Vercel, CI/CD GitHub Actions.

## 5. Industry Solutions

- **Healthcare (`/industries/ai-for-healthcare`)**: Medical symptom triage engines, automated clinic booking, and EHR sync platforms.
- **Education (`/industries/ai-for-education`)**: Intelligent student learning workspaces, voice grading assistants, and school administrative hubs.
- **Finance (`/industries/ai-for-finance`)**: Automated invoice processing, financial analytics dashboards, and transaction verification systems.
- **Retail & E-Commerce (`/industries/ai-for-retail`)**: Custom online stores, WhatsApp order alerts, and multi-channel inventory tracking.
- **Real Estate (`/industries/ai-for-real-estate`)**: Property listing directories, automated lead qualification funnels, and agent scheduling dashboards.
- **Agriculture (`/industries/ai-for-agriculture`)**: Crop diagnostic apps, soil advisory tools, and farm management dashboards.
- **Startups (`/industries/ai-for-startups`)**: Technical co-founding support, rapid MVP builds, and investor-ready software architectures.

## 6. Verified Project Case Studies

1. **Healthkinator**:
   - *Problem*: Patient wait times and inaccurate internet self-diagnosis.
   - *Solution*: AI symptom checker integrating verified medical datasets with real-time triage guidance.
   - *Outcome*: 80% reduction in preliminary patient intake triage time.
2. **Teacher Sathi**:
   - *Problem*: Educators spending 10+ hours weekly on manual administrative planning and grading.
   - *Solution*: Voice-activated pedagogical AI assistant tailored for curriculum guidelines and automated rubric grading.
   - *Outcome*: Saves educators 10+ hours weekly in lesson planning overhead.
3. **WeAct**:
   - *Problem*: Disconnected volunteer coordination during humanitarian emergency responses.
   - *Solution*: Geographic real-time volunteer matching dashboard integrated with automated SMS/WhatsApp alerts.
   - *Outcome*: Reduces emergency volunteer dispatch coordination time to under 3 minutes.
